messages:
elaine: Opening an expedited hotfix for encoder routing. We're seeing intermittent 5xx on long inputs. Built encoder:v1.9.0-hotfix. Requesting a short lifeboat-style rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) within the next 25m. No schema/migration changes. /cc @nick_p @ops-joe

nick_p: pls post deploy link and a clear rollback plan. also confirm smoke tests and whether kv-cache touched.

elaine: deploy: https://deploy.internal/redwood/deploys/1717005432. KV-cache unaffected. Smoke tests passed in staging. Rollback plan (manual + pin):
```
# revert image
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/encoder encoder=redwood/encoder:v1.8.9
# pin previous version to release-config to avoid auto-rolls
curl -X POST https://release-config.internal/pin -d '{"service":"encoder","version":"v1.8.9","reason":"rollback"}'
```
I'll add a short playbook to #eng-oncall.

deploybot: Deploy request received for encoder:v1.9.0-hotfix. CI: ✅ unit, ✅ integration, e2e flaky (non-blocking). Proposed expedited canary: 10% for 4m, auto-pause if error_rate > 1% for 2m. Reply "approve" or react :thumbsup:.

ops-joe: Oncall standby for 45m. I'm fine with expedited if we enforce the 4m gate and have rollback owner ready. I'll enable verbose traces.

nick_p: I'll own rollback if needed. Adding circuit-breaker: error_threshold=1%, window=2m. Also alert on p95 +15%.

elaine: updated rollout config with thresholds. Release note draft created: "Hotfix: encoder routing fix (v1.9.0-hotfix)". Will publish after success.

deploybot: Canary started at 1717005450 -> encoder:v1.9.0-hotfix @10%. Link: https://deploy.internal/redwood/deploys/1717005432/canary.

elaine: watching https://grafana.company/d/encoder/encoder-health. If error_rate >1% for 2m auto-pause and alert ops.

ops-joe: Canary steady at 3m: error_rate 0.3%, p95 stable. Proceed to 50% for 3m.

deploybot: Ramp to 50% at 1717005472.

nick_p: monitoring OK. tail-latency +1% at p95. All clear.

deploybot: Rollout to 100% completed at 1717005489.

elaine: No rollback required. Publishing release note and tagging post-release actions. Thanks all for quick responses. :rocket:

releasebot: Release note RN-473 published and deploy ledger entry L-9981 created (expedited).
